summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of its Extraordinary General Meeting held October 2, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of Tom Graney as a Member of the Board of Directors, to serve until the end of the Annual General Meeting 2027. The filing contains no transaction terms, no acquisition or divestiture activity, and no forced or abrupt management departure; it is a routine meeting-result disclosure. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated.
